property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, contract C calls transferFrom on the provided caddress for every index i from 0 to _tos.length-1 (i.e., it forwards calls to all recipients in the array); the mutant that starts the loop at 1 skips index 0 and thus fails to call transferFrom for some inputs where _tos.length>0 and index 0 is meaningful.
change_summary: Change the loop to iterate from 1 to _tos.length (skipping index 0), altering which addresses are called and thus external observable behavior.
